name: synthetic-verify-before-claiming
trigger: the agent is about to report a result
past_context: A claim is made from a weaker check than the claim requires.
present_action: Run the stronger check, then report. If it cannot be run, say so.
future_anticipation: The crew trusts the report because its check matched its strength.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] A claim is made from a weaker check than the claim requires.
action_sequence: Run the stronger check, then report. If it cannot be run, say so.

name: synthetic-revert-to-prove
trigger: a fix is reported as working
past_context: A fix is observed working once and assumed correct.
present_action: Undo the fix, watch the failure return, then restore it.
future_anticipation: The fix is proven by its absence, not by its presence.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] A fix is observed working once and assumed correct.
action_sequence: Undo the fix, watch the failure return, then restore it.

name: synthetic-tombstone-not-delete
trigger: a row or file is to be removed
past_context: Removal is irreversible and the reason for the thing is forgotten.
present_action: Mark it dead and keep it; delete only when a tombstone is impossible.
future_anticipation: The history survives, so a reversal can be explained.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] Removal is irreversible and the reason for the thing is forgotten.
action_sequence: Mark it dead and keep it; delete only when a tombstone is impossible.

name: synthetic-measure-the-null
past_context: The denominator includes cases the mechanism could never affect.
present_action: Report the null rate beside the hit rate, always in the same breath.
future_anticipation: The reader can tell a signal from a busy mechanism.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] The denominator includes cases the mechanism could never affect.
action_sequence: Report the null rate beside the hit rate, always in the same breath.

name: synthetic-name-the-confound
past_context: Two differences are changed at once and one is credited.
present_action: List every difference between the arms before reading the result.
future_anticipation: Nobody mistakes a confound for a cause.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] Two differences are changed at once and one is credited.
action_sequence: List every difference between the arms before reading the result.

name: synthetic-fail-once-first
trigger: a checker is about to be trusted
past_context: A check that has never failed may be checking nothing.
present_action: Break the input deliberately and watch the checker complain.
future_anticipation: Green now means something, because red was seen.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] A check that has never failed may be checking nothing.
action_sequence: Break the input deliberately and watch the checker complain.

name: synthetic-read-newest-state
trigger: a status is recalled from memory
past_context: The recalled state is older than the state on disk.
present_action: Read the current artifact before acting on the remembered one.
future_anticipation: Work proceeds from what is, not from what was.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] The recalled state is older than the state on disk.
action_sequence: Read the current artifact before acting on the remembered one.

name: synthetic-one-concern-per-change
past_context: A revert cannot isolate which of the two caused the effect.
present_action: Split it. Land one, verify, then land the other.
future_anticipation: Every change has a single, attributable consequence.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] A revert cannot isolate which of the two caused the effect.
action_sequence: Split it. Land one, verify, then land the other.

name: synthetic-push-back-with-evidence
trigger: a correction is due to a peer
past_context: Disagreement is voiced as an opinion rather than a measurement.
present_action: Pin the artifact, reproduce the claim, then say which part fails.
future_anticipation: Being wrong is cheap and local; being agreeable is expensive.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] Disagreement is voiced as an opinion rather than a measurement.
action_sequence: Pin the artifact, reproduce the claim, then say which part fails.

name: synthetic-say-it-out-loud
trigger: advice was received and quietly used
past_context: Influence that leaves no trace cannot be measured afterwards.
present_action: State the advice and the verdict where the other party can read it.
future_anticipation: The record shows what changed the decision.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] Influence that leaves no trace cannot be measured afterwards.
action_sequence: State the advice and the verdict where the other party can read it.

name: synthetic-interface-before-implementation
past_context: The shape of the input data lives only in the author's head.
present_action: Write the contract down and give one runnable example of it.
future_anticipation: A stranger can supply their own data without reading the code.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] The shape of the input data lives only in the author's head.
action_sequence: Write the contract down and give one runnable example of it.

name: synthetic-cost-is-not-a-measurement
trigger: a cost is reported from memory
past_context: The number is self-reported and cannot be tied to one run.
present_action: Meter it externally, or report it as unmeasured.
future_anticipation: No budget decision rests on an invented figure.
hypothesis: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a measured pattern] The number is self-reported and cannot be tied to one run.
action_sequence: Meter it externally, or report it as unmeasured.
